role_summary: Turns data into decisions: analysis, statistics, experimentation and machine-learning models, communicated through clear reporting and visualisation.

postings.title: Data Scientist
postings.summary: Analytics-focused data scientist building insights and decision tools for operational processes, with regular reporting for business leaders.
responsibilities: Build data-driven insights and decision tools for operations
Produce regular reporting and analysis for leaders
Maintain data accuracy and integrity through audits
Run in-depth investigations into business questions
requirements: Degree focused on Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science or Data Science
3+ years as an analytics engineer, product analyst or similar
Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI
SQL, Python and Pandas for extraction and analysis
